title: A proper morphism carrying an ample invertible sheaf is locally projective
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that a proper morphism admitting an ample invertible sheaf is locally projective (statement lines 10616-10620). The counted proof is short but contains a genuine two-step reduction: ampleness produces locally on the base an immersion into a projective space over that base, and properness of the source then upgrades that immersion to a closed immersion because the image of a proper scheme is closed (proof lines 10622-10628). It is H2 by the rule that a short proof containing a checkable construction or replacement is still H2: here the content is the replacement of an immersion by a closed immersion via properness, not a restatement or a bare citation.
